capabilities: Render PlantUML and Mermaid from fenced code blocks in notes
Open .puml and .mmd files in a view, edit or split viewer
Live-preview unsaved diagram drafts while typing
Export diagrams to PNG, SVG or ASCII art
Send diagram source to a PlantUML, Kroki or local render server
extras: Sends diagram source to the configured render server; in Split mode unsaved drafts are sent while typing unless 'Update split preview only on save' is enabled. No accounts, telemetry or ads.
intentEvidence: rendered by the plugin instead of the built-in Mermaid renderer
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid, and standalone PlantUML diagram files have no in-app viewer, editor or live preview.

requires.name: PlantUML server, Kroki or local render server

summary: Renders PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams from .puml/.mmd files and fenced code blocks, with view, edit and split modes.
